audit.whatIsWrong: The page never named a Riven ability (flagged in packet defects) and, worse, attributed her stun to the wrong spell in five places.
audit.why: Riven's stun is Ki Burst (W, 11/10/9/8/7s). Broken Wings (Q, 13s) is three chained casts whose THIRD hit knocks back — it does not stun. A player baiting a "Q-stun" is watching the wrong bar and eats the real stun anyway.
audit.corrected: Ki Burst named and correctly assigned in spikes[0], early, mid, whys[2] and wants.foe[0]; Broken Wings and Valor named with their cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: The late-game swing back to Riven was asserted without its mechanical cause.
audit.why: Riot's text for Blade of the Exile: she "gains Attack Damage and Range" plus one Wind Slash. The bonus RANGE is why a full-build Riven wins the isolated duel you think you can take — the page mentioned only burst and mobility.
audit.corrected: late now states the attack-range gain and ties the "don’t duel alone" rule to it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Valor was written as a plain dash.
audit.why: Riot's text: "Riven steps forward a short distance and blocks incoming damage" (10/9/8/7/6s) — it is a dash AND a damage block, which is why committing your burst into a fresh Valor accomplishes nothing. Broken Wings' third cast knocking back is also what displaces you out of your own Q sweetspot.
audit.corrected: early and mid now name Valor with its 10s cooldown, and the third-cast knockback is described instead of a phantom stun.

edits.before: This is Riven's window — her Q-stun and animation-cancel burst beat your combo before your sustain scales. Don't W until she's used her third Q or her E dash, or she'll cancel your setup and delete you. Trade only when you've baited a cooldown; otherwise give ground.
edits.after: This is Riven's window — Ki Burst (W) is an 11s point-blank stun and her animation-cancel burst beats your combo before your sustain scales. Don't W until she's spent her third Broken Wings cast or her Valor (E) dash, or she cancels your setup and deletes you. Trade only on a baited cooldown.

edits.before: Q-stun Aatrox out of his sweetspot combo
edits.after: Ki Burst you out of the sweetspot combo

edits.before: Levels 1-2 favour Riven — her mobility lets her poke with Q and dance out of your range, and a whiffed sweetspot leaves you open to her Q-Q-Q into E burst. Farm cleanly and don't throw out Q casts you can't finish. Keep E charges for her engage, not for chasing. Respect that she can animation-cancel faster than you can combo, so give ground unless you've baited a cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 favour Riven — Broken Wings (Q) is three chained casts on a 13s cooldown that let her poke and dance out of your range, and a whiffed sweetspot leaves you open to Q-Q-Q into Valor (E). Farm cleanly and don't throw Q casts you can't finish. Keep E charges for her engage, not for chasing. She animation-cancels faster than you combo, so give ground unless you've baited Ki Burst (W).

edits.before: From 3-5 Riven owns the fight: she wants to Q-stun you mid-cast and E out before your sweetspot into W pull and E drain can land. The rule is patience — never W until she's spent her third Q or her E dash, because both cancel your pull, and losing the animation-cancel war loses the trade. At 6 hold E to dash through her stun and R only after she commits her combo; even then her burst can win the exchange outright.
edits.after: From 3-5 Riven owns the fight: she wants to Ki Burst (W, 11s) you mid-cast and Valor out before your sweetspot into W pull and E drain can land. The rule is patience — never W until she's spent the third Broken Wings cast or her 10s Valor, because both cancel your pull, and losing the animation-cancel war loses the trade. At 6 hold E to dash through the stun and R only after she commits; her burst can still win outright.

edits.before: At 3 her animation-cancel combo and Q-stun beat your fresh Q casts.
edits.after: At 3 her animation-cancels and Ki Burst stun beat your fresh Q casts.

edits.before: Your first item — Eclipse or Profane Hydra — is the one swing point in your favour, because Riven's damage is burst on cooldowns and yours becomes relentless sustain. Extend every fight past her E and Wind Slash and the drain grinds her down. Late game tips back to Riven: she keeps burst and mobility, so play with your team and R uptime rather than dueling her isolated. Don't get caught alone where she can combo-and-dash on repeat.
edits.after: Your first item — Eclipse or Profane Hydra — is the one swing point in your favour, because Riven's damage is burst on cooldowns and yours becomes relentless sustain. Extend every fight past Valor and Wind Slash and the drain grinds her down. Blade of the Exile also gives her ATTACK RANGE, so late she duels you from further out than you expect: play with your team and R uptime rather than dueling her alone.

notes: Aatrox's Infernal Chains (W) carries a derived "grounding" flag Riot's description does not support (drag + slow only); no grounding claim was made in this slice.
